question: In the Curse of Strahd introductory adventure (Death House), what object is found inside the small wooden coffer in the prison area (Area 36)?

bm25_simple.answer: A dire wolf's withered tongue. Note: the coffer is technically in Area 35 (Reliquary), not Area 36 (Prison). Source: Curse of Strahd Introductory Adventure.pdf p.11.
sources_cited: Curse of Strahd Introductory Adventure.pdf p.11

quality.notes: Correct answer. Helpfully noted the area number discrepancy (Area 35 vs 36).
